description: This header file declares exported API functions for the BREE (BSP Run-time Execution Engine) object, including creation, removal, enrollment of objects, and initialization functions as part of the BroadWay Service Delivery System.

methods.name: BreeCreateSpo
methods.description: Creates an instance of the BREE SPO object with provided context handles.

methods.name: BreeSpoCreate
methods.description: Creates a BREE SPO object with specified context handles.

methods.name: BreeSpoRemove
methods.description: Removes a BREE SPO object identified by the given handle.

methods.name: BreeSpoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary objects within the BREE SPO context.
